title: Worship
definition: Worship is the reverent response of the whole person to God’s glory, grace, truth, and worth, expressed in faith, obedience, praise, prayer, service, and surrender.
summary: Worship is not limited to music or gatherings. It includes the life yielded to God through Christ and shaped by His Word.
christFocus: Christ is the center and mediator of true worship. Through Him believers come to the Father by the Spirit in reverence, gratitude, and truth.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: True worship involves spirit and truth.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: All of life becomes worship when surrendered to God through Christ.
